# Juan Carlos Carrera Realtors Mortgage Calculator

> Educational mortgage payment calculator for comparing estimated monthly payments across different home price ranges.

## About

This website provides an educational mortgage payment comparison tool from Juan Carlos Carrera Realtors.

Users can compare estimated monthly housing payments based on:

- Purchase price range
- Loan type
- Down payment
- Interest rate
- Loan term
- Principal and interest
- FHA MIP or conventional PMI
- Property taxes
- Homeowners insurance

The calculator is available in English and Spanish.

## Purpose

The purpose of this website is to help prospective homebuyers understand how changes in home price and financing assumptions may affect an estimated monthly mortgage payment.

The results are educational estimates only and do not constitute:

- A mortgage approval
- A preapproval
- An official loan estimate
- Financial advice
- A guarantee of financing terms

Users should confirm actual loan terms and monthly payments with a licensed mortgage lender.

## Main Page

- [Mortgage Payment Calculator](https://paymentmonthly.homelasvegasnevada.com/): Compare estimated monthly mortgage payments by home price.

## Important Calculation Information

The estimated total monthly payment may include:

- Principal
- Interest
- FHA MIP or conventional PMI
- Property taxes
- Homeowners insurance

HOA fees are not included in the calculation.

Actual payments may vary based on the lender, credit profile, loan program, property, insurance premium, taxes, and other financing conditions.
